runs.question: Which OMB memo currently governs how federal agencies acquire AI, and what happened to the earlier acquisition memo?

answer.text:
**Current governing memo: OMB M-25-22.** It is the April 2025 memo, *Driving Efficient Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government*. Its own text says it rescinds and replaces 0MB Memorandum M-24-18, Advancing the Responsible Acquisition ofArtificial Intelligence in Government. The replacement is explicit, so M-25-22 governs over the earlier memo.

**What happened to M-24-18:** The October 2024 memo (dated September 24, 2024 on its first page) was the earlier acquisition memo. M-25-22 rescinds and replaces it, so it is no longer the operative guidance. The documents I searched do not say how agencies should handle contracts that were already in place under M-24-18.

**Scope of M-25-22:** The memo applies to any contract awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance of this memorandum, as well as to any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract after the date that is 180 days after the issuance of this memorandum. It also does not apply to AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System.
